FIRST SLICE of bd-01M1697234KP2X44X6Q8S6C6Y7, pre-scoped by the chief so it can start the moment the reference shape lands. BLOCKED UNTIL the population reference shape (bd-01M15XZ290HDMPTA4NXP88G4CM) is on main - copy its shape, do not invent one.

TEN TYPES, all in embed-core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/embed/: ValidatedVector (vector.scala:10), EmbeddingReceipt (receipt.scala:223), ItemDigest (receipt.scala:197), CacheKey (cache.scala:14), SensitiveDigest (digest.scala:41), EmbeddingSpace (identity.scala:264), GeometryPair (identity.scala:417), RemoteCapability (privacy.scala:743), AuthorizedRemoteRequest (privacy.scala:772), EmbedBatch (contract.scala:33).

ORDER WITHIN THE SLICE, by what the type certifies rather than by file order: ValidatedVector first (its of() rejects dimension mismatch, non-finite values, non-L2-normalized vectors and the zero vector - four checks, all bypassed, and a forged one makes every downstream distance and neighbour ranking compute on NaN while announcing itself as validated), then EmbeddingReceipt / ItemDigest / SensitiveDigest (privacy invariants: withheld identities describing a provider call, keyed items without keyed outputs), then CacheKey / EmbeddingSpace / GeometryPair (identity), then RemoteCapability / AuthorizedRemoteRequest / EmbedBatch.

SHAPE, per AGENTS.md rule 8: final NON-case class, public read accessors unchanged, structural equals/hashCode, intentional toString, construction private to the smart constructor. ONE DOOR ONLY - fromProduct. Do NOT add negative probes for copy (suppressed by a private constructor; verified with a control), nor for unapply/_1/_2/Product (read-only, construct nothing, and every field here is public anyway). None of these ten hides a field, so the rule-8 exception does not apply.

REFERENCE SCOPE, computed mechanically per rule 3 rather than assumed - the gate MUST cover all three: embed-core, embed-bench, embed-grakern. ValidatedVector and EmbeddingSpace are referenced by all three; EmbeddingReceipt and ItemDigest by embed-core and embed-grakern; CacheKey and SensitiveDigest by embed-core alone. embed-grakern is JVM-only (plain target dir), embed-core is cross-built.

GATE: scalafmtCheckAll; scalafmtSbtCheck; compileAll; embedCoreJVM/test; embedCoreJS/test; embedCoreNative/test; embedBench/test; embedGrakern/test. UNPIPED, redirected to a file, report the command's own exit status (rule 4). Shape mutations proved after a CLEAN recompile, stated in the evidence post (rule 4).

EVIDENCE STANDARD, set by m1 and binding: DEMONSTRATE the forge, do not assert it - one line building an invalid instance via fromProduct, plus the mutation showing the closed version rejects it. Start with ValidatedVector: if fromProduct does NOT reproduce a NaN or unnormalized vector there, say so loudly and the chief withdraws the 45-count rather than defending it.
